head.name: @fzlt/core/sprite
head.lead: The character layer's drawing primitive. Pixel-art sprites written as data (rows of characters + a colour map whose values can be palette roles), baked once per (sprite, frame, scale, palette) into a bounded cache, then blitted with one drawImage. spriteSVG() / spriteURL() give the same pixels as an SVG for characters that live in the page instead of on a canvas; they stand alone, so a page that only places SVG characters never ships the canvas half.

sizesNote: Measured on this build: minified and gzipped with everything it imports, the way npm run size checks the budget in CI.
